body:
You know now R3 is out and that you need to try the new cards right. Well I was up all night trying to build decks with what little R3 I had. The reason I did this was because I was so upset that I didn’t get my box of R3 yet that was the big decision maker and the only R3 I had was from the pre-release of R3. I tell you it wasn’t much.



Well I spend all night trying to make decks and talking to friends trying to get ideas and well their Ideas were all around R3 Objectives that I just did not have plan a simple. So with about ten minutes I was able to make a Dark side walker garrison with major planet security and executor always up second turn. Also with imperial commands of course. Well my light I went through so many old and new decks it wasn’t funny. First I thought Hidden Base mains with some Alderaan retrieval then I said no because I was afraid of maul in ship well I was so wrong this would have killed the @#$% of all the new and old decks. The second was mad x-wing ebo with the new effect again maul in ship for my big drains to be canceled again wrong.

The thing I picked as a dumbass was Coursant mains with SAC and destiny adders.





First Game



Michael Kissling Dark Solid senators Vs My Coursant Mains LS



Well first of we gave no force Icons to each other the entire game except for my Coursant DB and his senator hut. Well the game starts of with maul to the site of course the second is setting up the second site the chamber. Well I could ask for a more god hand my spy lando w ax and my obi with draw fire and some SAC. First what I do is get my 0-1 db out then get honor out and stop the damage for a little while. I wait

 Till I have the force to play a beat down on lone maul. About 3rd or 4th turn I go for it and wack maul for all he’s worth and get two destiny in the process I cause over flow of 10 that was the only big battle of the game. The rest was trying to block my drains with spies and well I have to say I played like a dumb ass. After I ask him how much he has in his life force I pick up.

 Props

Maul out with OCC/TT

Kill the @#$% out of maul



Slops

Not realizing that I should use my spy killer during my control phase not during his

Throwing Luke w stick to the chamber not realizing that his game text gets canceled

And Home ones game text so I could drain at his db



FL

O(-15)



My friends rip on me then.





Second Game



Some random scrub LS  Vs My Dark Garrison aka the machine



Well first his light side was senotors I sat in my chair and laughed my @#$% off I own I said in my head.

He also has some podracing in it but I said who cares lets see at it yo. I get exector out second turn and deal him some damage and set up imperal decree. I set up walker garrison and drain the @#$% out of him and also out activate him by 10. I guees the only balls that he had was to db transit to my db with jedi and take my on I said ok keep in mind I have battle deployment on table. He has some random jedi, Yoda, and daughter of Skywalker with the stick. I have Blizzard  1  with the general on board and in the hand I have 4-lom and ig-88 with gun with command. Can we say game over. He chops my Ig 88 and 4 lom to cancel yoda game text I draw mad destiny to his one I draw 15 in destiny with my power its just tech clear the site and walker garrison owned the game.

No props or slops I won



FW +19

2(+5)









Third game my Ls Vs Huntdown of a scrub



Well I go about my business and take damage from the hologram till I get honor out and Goo Nee Tay out because I gave him like no force the entire game he blind duel me I win vader gone. Then I drain for 1 at coursant db and he takes damage from the hologram. The he tries to come after yoda and lukes in hand and I say who cares when I got two 6 s on top of my deck drop luke no surprise come obsession and I win mara gone lose to own obj that game.



FW +24



4(+29)



Props

Winning with trash

Him blind dueling me took balls



Slops

None I won





Forth Game



My Dark Garrison Vs Wills Gilchrist The new obj lightsaber combat



Me and will were talking about this match up on IM and we both new that Garrison owns the new obj hands down. My hand was god all the force activation he gave me game over I deployed my blizzard 4 and grabbed  Adrimal Piett with it and scince I had what I wanted I got battle deployment out of deck. Set up

Got executor out second turn the only thing I hate is the up keep. He got his new Qui gon out

walker garrison up 4th  turn  and I said game over he transited some guys over to the hoth db. Trampled the caption P with the blaster and had my way with them. Another garrison and that was game.



FW +14



6(+43)



Good enough for 3rd



Props

getting some R3 cards for free

Playing mike

Killing will Jkl Dont rate this on this comment will



Slops

Not playing any ebo decks

Me not playing ebo

Me not playing HB

Not winning the foils

No Paul Myers Jkl maybe we can play next time

My winning LS coursant mains who won that is trash

Taking 3rd

Only 4 games
title: Smyran GA 11-3-01
author: Damian Loback

games.note: report spells the name 'Michael Kissling'; Maul out with OCC/TT

games.opponent_objective: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe
We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates

decks.description: Walker Garrison with Major Planet Security and Executor
Coruscant mains with SAC and destiny adders

summary: Damian Loback finished 3rd at a tournament in Smyrna, Georgia, on 3 November 2001, going 3–1 with a Dark Walker Garrison deck and a Light Coruscant mains deck; his only loss was to Mike Kessling.
notes: Place and date from the report title 'smyran-ga-11-3-01' (Smyrna, Georgia, misspelt in the slug and kept in the title); the body names no store. No November 2001 Smyrna event on the List (October 2001 Smyrna tournament is 6 October); new 'November 2001 Smyrna tournament'.
Format Premiere - Reflections III: 'now R3 is out', R3 cards from the pre-release and the new R3 objective played in game 4.
'Michael Kissling' mapped to [[Mike Kessling]] (Georgia player in 2001: 2001 Georgia State Championship 2nd; [[Michael Kessling]] redirects there).

Game 4 'The new obj lightsaber combat' (new Qui-Gon) = the R3 Light objective We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates. Game 3 'Huntdown' linked to Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi. Game 1 'Dark Solid senators' and game 2 LS 'senotors' not linked (vague).
Points line: the report gives 2 (+5) after game 2 (−15 +19 = +4) and ends 6 (+43); author_points keeps the report's 6 (+43).
'Good enough for 3rd'; 'Not winning the foils', 'Only 4 games'. Players and winner not stated.

A live deck page [[Damian Loback the new garrison that owns land and space]] (Dark, R3, posted 5 November 2001) is probably this Walker Garrison deck, but the report doesn't link it, so deck_page null.
